subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this provider-backed WeChat hot-reload change show redacted live account A+B QR-login proof before merge, or is the focused gateway lifecycle regression evidence sufficient?
rationale: The code-level regressions cover the intended manager lifecycle and prior race conditions, but only a real provider session can confirm the external account listing and QR-login timing that motivated the fix.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup provides redacted after-fix evidence that account A stays online while account B is added.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused gateway lifecycle tests and normal checks as sufficient for this bounded reload-hand-off fix.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
